messages.subject: Re: Trellis with more than one variable
parts:
See ?facet_grid

In the examples:
qplot(mpg, wt, data=mtcars, facets = . ~ vs + am)
qplot(mpg, wt, data=mtcars, facets = vs + am ~ . )

Looks like all you need to do is use +.
